The '''Algunnis system''' was a [[Binary star/Legends|binary star]] [[Star system/Legends|system]] located within the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
The Algunnis system was a [[Binary star/Legends|binary star]] [[Star system/Legends|system]] located in the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]]<ref name="GMK" /> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].. The system contained no [[Planet/Legends|planets]], but did include a large [[Algunnis asteroid belt|asteroid belt]]<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
During the formation of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] theorized that the binary star [[Algunnis]] passed close to several star system, capturing young planets and crushing them into a massive [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] with its [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational]] pull. The system was devoid of settlers by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], but did contain [[Exogorth/Legends|space slugs]].<ref name="GMK" />
